title: ActionDoll, active ragdolls for Roblox
description:
A Roblox library for making active ragdolls: physics-driven characters that balance, stumble, fall and get back up instead of playing canned animations. It comes with Sangine, a character system that does away with Roblox's Humanoid entirely, so you can build fully physics-based games.
I developed it over two years and released it for free on the Roblox Developer Forum, with four example places: capsule characters in a breach-and-entry game, R6 characters with R6 and R15 ragdoll rigs (a SWAT game and a Squid Game style game), and a crisis response game with static-animation characters. Other developers have since built their own games on it.
howItWorks:
Each limb is a physics body held together by constraints, and motors drive the joints toward a target pose so the character keeps its balance while still reacting to hits, falls and collisions. Ragdoll state is replicated smoothly to every player.
The library is modular and array-based, so it works with active or passive ragdolls and is easy to adapt to other rigs, for example turning the R6 setup into R15.
